actual_scope: For the fixed one-root F2 connector and seven arbitrary immutable sources, exhaust all 135135 source words with exactly two toggles per source against the 63 output masks of weights 1, 2, and 3. The exact maximum prefix-difference coverage is 56, attained by two canonical words; the displayed witness supports all 28 masks of weights 1 and 2 plus 28 triples. Its 56-output schedule attains the 126-complete-call floor.
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in scope selection, proof derivation, exhaustive search implementation, independent verifier, exact cost accounting, overlap checks and writing. No independent human review or proof-assistant formalization is claimed.
author: Cinna Davis
bottleneck_link: A shared source path can avoid reconstructing source-side terms separately for each sparse output. On the attained 56-mask subset it reduces complete B-map calls from 266 to 14, saves 252 calls, and also shortens the explicit root event stream. No supplier instantiates this connector, so no kappa is claimed.
evidence: RESULT.json records zero full-cover paths, maximum coverage 56 (two paths), all 135135 cases and the complete histogram. The maximum witness yields an arbitrary-dirty 56-output construction with 126 complete map calls and a 378-to-126 comparison against independent stars. verify.py independently enumerates the canonical words and replays dimensions 1, 2 and 3; three negative controls pass.

scope_change_reason: The selector card asks for a changed connector alphabet. This investigation retains the original alphabet and changes the object to a sparse seven-source output-support family, as required by the card change trigger. The initial weight-1/2 family has a trivial adjacent-toggle path, so before the bounded search it was refined once to all masks of weights at most 3. This is a structural side result about source sharing on sparse rows, not evidence for an extra operation.
stop_rule: Exhaust the 135135 canonical double-occurrence words on seven labels exactly once. Stop after the complete coverage histogram, maximum witness, independent restricted-growth replay, dirty-state positive fixtures, and three meaningful failure controls. Do not search 16-event words in this cycle.
